description: Verified crisis contacts rendered into a single shared block and injected at build time onto safety-facing surfaces of both clerkship sites. This file is the ONLY place these numbers are maintained — never hand-edit the rendered block in a content page.

provenance.note: The ReConnect Psychiatry System is the upstream steward for crisis-resource data and runs a scheduled verification steward that stages corrections for human review rather than self-editing crisis numbers. This snapshot is DERIVED from that dataset, not an exact copy: each value below was independently re-verified against its official source on the recorded date. A live cross-repo import is deliberately not used — Netlify checks out only this repo, so an absolute path to the ReConnect working copy does not exist on the build runner, and CLAUDE.md forbids hard-coded /Users paths in tracked .py (CI lints for it). See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-27-crisis-contacts-988-design.md for what a true live import would require.
provenance.upstreamFreshnessCaveat: At snapshot time ReConnect's own quality guard reported the crisis category at 10.2% fresh (115 of 128 records past its 90-day window), with open handoffs HANDOFF_crisis_freshness_20260720.md and HANDOFF_P0_crisis_alerts_20260720.md. Values here were therefore verified against official sources directly rather than copied from upstream.

upstreamDiscrepancies.action: Clerkship snapshot uses the verified value. Correction should be filed upstream against ReConnect.

unitEscalationNote: On the unit, a patient in immediate danger is an escalation to your supervising resident or attending and the charge nurse — not a phone call. These lines are what you put IN a patient's safety plan, what families use after discharge, and what you can use yourself.

resources.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
resources.note: Spanish available by call, text, and chat; a dedicated line serves Deaf/Hard-of-Hearing callers. Calls placed in Maine route to Maine crisis specialists.

resources.name: Crisis Text Line
resources.note: Text-only. Often the most acceptable option for adolescents and young adults who will not make a phone call.

resources.name: Maine Crisis Line
resources.alsoAvailable: Text and chat available via the Maine Crisis Line website
resources.note: Staffed by clinically trained crisis workers and the gateway to Maine's mobile crisis teams — the number that actually dispatches a face-to-face response.

resources.name: Veterans Crisis Line
resources.note: No VA enrollment required. Ask about service history — it changes which line is the right referral.
